name: VISTA flash loan burns frozen presale balances as repayment
summary: VISTA's built-in flash-loan path burns the borrowed amount from the borrower on repayment without checking that the burned balance is the unfrozen part, so the attacker borrowed VISTA, had its frozen presale allocation burned as repayment while keeping the loaned tokens free, and sold them into the VISTA/USDT pair.
notes: Loss is the VISTA/USDT pair's USDT; the VISTA it received is valued at nothing (rule 12).
